notes:
Pilot overview: Northport ran a 2-week Hosted API pilot focused on chat-based customer support and semantic search across their KB. Key ask: low-latency chat for paying customers and a cost-effective path for nightly embedding batches. They emphasized wanting predictable latency (SLA-ish: ~150ms p50 gen) and clear cost controls when moving to Dedicated. Quote from product lead: "If we can lock in predictable throughput and a transparent per-token economics, we can move to Reserved capacity."

Trial observations: steady-state QPS 3-6 for interactive users with spikes up to ~12 QPS during support peak windows. Embeddings jobs ran in nightly batches (high token counts but tolerant latency). Average observed request token footprint during trial: prompt ~120 tokens, generation ~320 tokens (avg total ~440 tokens); variability for long-summary flows up to 1.2k tokens. No PII persisted in logs per their current config, but compliance wants KMS + retention controls.

Why Dedicated now: team wants predictable concurrency during peak support events, VPC/private networking, and the ability to fine-tune batching/quantization recommendations from Redwood Optimize to reduce unit cost. Next-phase asks: detailed QPS-to-GPU sizing, fallback policy for model variants, and a pricing band for a 12-month reserved commitment.

POC outcomes so far: SE ran a cost/latency simulation matrix (attached doc) and recommended a baseline Dedicated pool sized for 25 sustained QPS with headroom to 70 QPS bursts, initial concurrency target ~140 to account for long-context sessions and KV-cache overhead. Customer asked for a short (30-day) pilot on Dedicated before annual commit to validate end-to-end networking and latency SLOs.
qps_forecast: Steady-state 18 QPS during business hours, peak bursts 60-75 QPS (support flash events)
concurrency_target: Baseline 140 concurrent requests (includes KV-cache and prefetch), scale rules to 220 for unexpected spikes
avg_tokens_per_request: ~450 tokens average during chat flows; embeddings jobs produce batches equivalent to 50k-600k tokens nightly
